title: aregelia coriacea
intro: Aregelia coriacea, commonly known as Aregelia or Desert Ironwood, is a slow-growing, deciduous tree native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal and cultural significance, with the bark and roots being used to create a medicinal paste. The health benefits of Aregelia coriacea include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and provide relief from pain and fever. The bioactive constituents of Aregelia coriacea include tannins, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including astringency, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
